texts.label: A
texts.title: The shorter meeting
texts.text: Our weekly meeting became shorter after we circulated the difficult questions in advance. The change did not reduce disagreement; it moved disagreement to a better moment, when people had had time to prepare evidence. The meeting now feels more demanding and more useful.

texts.label: B
texts.title: The shared studio
texts.text: The studio’s new layout was intended to improve collaboration, but its unexpected benefit was concentration. People could see one another without being forced into constant conversation. The room made it easier to ask for help and easier to decline it.

texts.label: C
texts.title: The handover note
texts.text: I used to finish a project by sending a final message. Now I write a short handover note for the person who will inherit the work. It takes longer, but it exposes decisions that seemed obvious to me and prevents the next person from restarting the investigation.

texts.label: D
texts.title: The quiet hour
texts.text: The company introduced an hour without internal messages. At first it felt symbolic, since urgent work still interrupted it. Gradually, however, teams began protecting the hour for tasks that required uninterrupted attention. The rule worked because people adapted it rather than obeying it perfectly.

questions.prompt: Which change gave people information before a discussion?
questions.explanation: Questions were circulated in advance so people could prepare evidence.

questions.prompt: Which change improved both contact and personal boundaries?
questions.explanation: The layout made it easier to ask for help and decline it.

questions.prompt: Which change was designed to help a successor?
questions.explanation: The handover note is written for the person inheriting the work.

questions.prompt: Which change became effective through flexible use?
questions.explanation: Teams adapted the quiet hour instead of obeying it perfectly.

questions.prompt: Which writer says disagreement has not disappeared?
questions.explanation: The shorter meeting did not reduce disagreement; it improved its timing.

questions.prompt: Which account mentions an unintended benefit?
questions.explanation: The layout was intended to improve collaboration but unexpectedly improved concentration.

questions.prompt: Which change reveals decisions that might otherwise seem obvious?
questions.explanation: Writing the handover note exposes assumptions and decisions.

questions.prompt: Which account describes a rule that was initially difficult to take seriously?
questions.explanation: The quiet hour first felt symbolic because urgent work still interrupted it.

questions.prompt: Which account values preparation over brevity?
questions.explanation: The meeting is shorter but more demanding because evidence is prepared beforehand.

questions.prompt: Which account says a physical arrangement can support optional interaction?
questions.explanation: The studio allows people to see one another without forcing conversation.
